scope: Two 64-step arms - the published read-out and the same read-out with the declared dense class-balanced hinge added to the occupancy objective - captured in one catalogue and scored read-only at the standing 0.0 boundary and over the standing 81-point grid. The hinge is supervision: it names no threshold, counts no class frequency (0.5/0.5 is equal class weight), reads no prevalence and adds no parameter, and 0 is exactly the published objective. No threshold change, no population change and no real-image, complete-state or quality claim.

mechanism.name: dense-class-balanced-hinge
mechanism.definition: per qualifying board 0.5*mean_occupied relu(margin - logit) + 0.5*mean_empty relu(margin + logit) over known visible cells, mean over boards carrying both classes
mechanism.balance_is: equal class weight, never a cell count or a population statistic
mechanism.unknown_cells: excluded from both sides, so an invisible cell is never read as empty
mechanism.identity_at_zero: occupancy_dense_hinge 0 is exactly the published objective
mechanism.supersedes: the M11 quantile anchor, the M10 two-sided anchor and the M9 one-sided hinge; the trainer refuses all four together
mechanism.fit_gate_implication: every known cell a full margin from 0.0 on its correct side implies the 0.0 decision reproduces the label on every board

training_dense.reading: the band charge the objective paid on its own training batch; it is zero only when every known cell is a full margin from the boundary a consumer applies

reference.role: reference-only: the M10 two-sided extremal anchor, the M11 class-quantile anchor and the M9 one-sided hinge, each measured in its own catalogue and none re-measured or re-verdicted here, so a reader can see the whole progression from two cells, to a tenth of each class, to every cell

reading_text: Charging every known cell does not put the plain-binary boundary above control's, so no supervision of the read's shape places `0.0` on this data and the next arm has to remove the read's free additive level itself instead of charging around it.
secondary_text: Deciding AUC is reported beside the primary metric with M8/M9/M10/M11's declared tolerance of -0.02 so the passes are comparable: this is the strongest constraint tried so far, so a ranking loss here is the measured price of buying the operating point rather than a surprise.

fit_gate.implication: satisfaction of the band forces every known cell a full margin from 0.0 on its correct side, so it implies an exact 0.0 boundary on every board
